subject: Ledger tag mismatch — vendor onboarding stub assign & spend band recovery
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@bluehalo.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, procure@bluehalo.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — missing purchase-ref and spend cap on item lines

Hi Hannah,

We're completing the Redwood onboarding packet for BlueHalo and hit two items the vendor portal didn't auto-assign: the internal purchase reference and the spend band on two SKU lines. Finance is holding the first invoice until a purchase-ref is assigned and lines are split correctly.

Quick summary:
- Line A (SKU BH-ML-01): unit price OK but quantity shows 0 in the ledger export.
- Line B (SKU BH-SVC-TR): shows cap of $75k but the vendor expected $50k (we accidentally selected the wrong spend bracket).

I've attached the onboarding form we submitted (onboarding_form.pdf) and a screenshot of the vendor portal. Can someone assign a provisional purchase-ref so our AP can receive the invoice? Also need guidance on how Redwood prefers to record the line split (single PO with two line items vs two POs).

We'd like to get this cleared before EOD Wednesday to avoid delaying services.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Lead, BlueHalo
liam@bluehalo.com
(attachment: onboarding_form.pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@bluehalo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — missing purchase-ref and spend cap on item lines

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the friction. We're going to triage this as follows:

1) Assign a provisional purchase reference so AP can accept the invoice.
2) Reconcile the spend cap with Finance (Ben) and propose whether to change the bracket or split into two lines/POs.
3) If a corrected onboarding form is needed, we'll ask BlueHalo to resubmit and we'll attach the corrected form to the PO.

Ben / Monica — can you take ownership? Ben, please pull the ledger export and confirm why quantity for BH-ML-01 came through as 0. Monica, if Finance needs the spend bracket reduced to $50k we should note the change on the purchase-ref metadata.

I'll follow up with the provisional ref once Ben confirms.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(Office) +1 415-555-0172

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — missing purchase-ref and spend cap on item lines

Hannah / team — I pulled the ledger export and ran a quick reconciliation. Findings:

- BH-ML-01: vendor submitted a CSV with quantity in the "units_shipped" column but our ingestion pipeline maps "qty". The value ended up null -> displayed as 0. I've attached ledger_snapshot.csv with the raw rows (ledger_snapshot.csv).
- BH-SVC-TR: the onboarding form had the wrong spend bracket selected (vendor ticked ">50k" but portal interpreted as the next band). Easy fix on our side — either change the spend band to $50k or split the service into two line items (initial implementation + support).

Proposed immediate remediation:
1) Assign provisional purchase-ref PR-2026-7541 to hold this account and let AP receive the invoice.
2) Correct the ingestion mapping so BH-ML-01 quantity flows through (we'll push a hotfix to the parser this afternoon).
3) For spend cap, recommend we change the band to $50k now, and if BlueHalo expects staged billing we can later split the line into two PO lines and reissue.

I can assign PR-2026-7541 as a temporary ref once Hannah approves.

(attachment: ledger_snapshot.csv)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

On Mon, Jun 15, 2026 at 10:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the friction. We're going to triage this as follows:
> ...

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@bluehalo.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — missing purchase-ref and spend cap on item lines

Thanks Ben — that mapping bug explains the 0 quantity. Hannah, I'm good with the provisional ref but a couple of notes from Finance:

- We will flag PR-2026-7541 as provisional and set a 30-day reconciliation window. Finance will hold payment if the final purchase-ref is different. Please tell BlueHalo to note "PR-2026-7541 (provisional)" on the invoice to avoid a AP reject.
- For the spend cap: Finance prefers we correct the band to $50,000 immediately if vendor confirms — fewer bookkeeping headaches than splitting and reissuing two POs. If BlueHalo confirms staged billing, we can split the service line later and create an amendment.

Liam — can you ask your finance contact to confirm they accept $50,000 as the band for BH-SVC-TR? Also upload an updated onboarding_form with the corrected spend bracket so we have a clean record. I've attached a short template they can use (onboarding_form_updated.pdf).

I'll schedule the provisional ref assignment once we have vendor confirmation.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Ops Finance, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(attachment: onboarding_form_updated.pdf)

Monica / Hannah — confirmed with our finance team: they accept $50,000 for the BH-SVC-TR line. We'll re-upload the corrected onboarding form (attached) and place the note "PR-2026-7541 (provisional)" on the first invoice.

Also attaching BlueHalo's supplier certificate you requested (vendor_certificate.pdf). Once you change the band and assign the provisional ref we'll push the invoice. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Thanks,
